Lands as one predicate in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (+ objectui twin when that repo's patrol takes it). The rule itself is not re-stated — the card is correct that it isn't missing. Fold-candidate with #11706 (both are patrol-predicate additions) rather than with the doc-amendment trio.
